description: October 5 birthday meaning: Libra decan 2, birthday number 5, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 5 birthday falls in Libra, in the second decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 5. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: October 5 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Is there such a thing as too many interesting people? For someone born on the 5th of October, probably not. Twelve degrees of Libra places the Sun in the second decan, flavoured by Uranus's appetite for the unusual, and the birthday number 5 brings freedom and movement. Interpretively, this is a sociable experimenter who collects friends, ideas and places with equal enthusiasm.

On October 5 the Sun usually sits at about 12° Libra, in the second decan, where Uranus is the sub-ruler alongside Venus. The middle stretch of Libra, roughly October 3 to October 13, takes Uranus as sub-ruler, the planet associated with Aquarius in modern astrology. This tends to turn the sign's interest in fairness towards society at large. Natives are often pictured as idealistic, progressive and drawn to groups, networks and causes. Their relationships may be unconventional, or built on friendship and shared values more than tradition. Uranus brings originality and also a cool, detached streak when emotions run high. Combining their sense of justice with personal warmth usually helps them persuade rather than simply be right.

sections.heading: October 5 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 5th, your birthday number is 5, sitting at the exact midpoint of the single digits. Numerologists read the day of birth as a secondary note, a personal knack rather than a fixed fate. The 5 is linked with movement, the senses and curiosity, so a 5th birthday is traditionally associated with adaptability and a low tolerance for monotony. These people often learn fastest by doing and enjoy travel, variety and new company. Freedom matters to them, and so does choosing which commitments are worth the trade, since restlessness can otherwise scatter a great deal of energy.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one October 5 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on October 5: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 5 is the 278th day of the year (279th in a leap year). By October 24, 19 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Scorpio.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by October 5, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on October 5 include Denis Diderot (1713), Václav Havel (1936) and Kate Winslet (1975).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 5?
faq.answer: October 5 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Libra, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 5?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 5 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 5 for everyone born on the 5th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 5?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 5 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 5?
faq.answer: October 5 is also the birthday of Denis Diderot (1713), Václav Havel (1936) and Kate Winslet (1975). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
